notes: Honest corrections only: geometry, crop, exposure, white balance, contrast, mild noise reduction and sharpening. Nothing added, removed or retouched. Originals untouched. focal is the point crops should centre on, as fractions of the output image.

edits: keystone correction so the wall edges are vertical
cropped out the rooftop and cable foreground
lifted the shaded half of the wall with a gentle curve
slight warm-up of the blue shade cast
photos.note: Hard diagonal sun shadow across the wall is in the scene and cannot be edited out honestly.

edits: keystone correction (85 percent) so the banner and columns stand upright
cropped out the out-of-focus grass foreground
photos.note: Shot from low on the ground; correction recovers most of it. Overcast light is flat but even.

edits: perspective correction (85 percent) so the lettering reads nearly level
cropped to the sign wall, removing the dark side panel
white balance to take out the yellow-green flash cast
photos.note: Original is heavily compressed and the sign touches the top-right edge of the frame; no spare room for the site to crop further. Left side is soft after correction.

edits: trimmed empty sidewalk and edge clutter
photos.note: Licence plate is legible; consider whether the client is happy with that. A few leaves intrude top-left and could not be cropped without cutting the lift gate.
Source is 460 px wide and was already over-sharpened. Nothing can restore missing detail.

edits: perspective correction so the fascia is level instead of running diagonally
photos.note: Original was a digital-zoom shot from below and is soft. Reads well at card size, not large.

edits: cropped to the sign, removing the flower arrangements, fire alarm and wall controls
photos.note: Top of the sign sits 35 px from the frame edge in the original, a flower stem still intrudes bottom-left, and ceiling lights reflect in the glossy letters. None of that can be edited honestly.

edits: slight contrast so the thread stands out
photos.note: Small source (799 px). Fine for a service card, not for a large banner.

edits: cropped to the imprint, removing the fingers and empty desk
photos.note: It is still a pen on an office desk. The crop has to cut both ends of the pen because the original already cut off the tip.

edits: cropped out the printer, water bottle, desk and blown-out ceiling light
exposure +0.3 stop so the dark wall is not muddy
photos.note: Perspective correction was tested and rejected: it distorted the round logo. The secondary sign on the right is slightly out of focus in the original.
Already a well-made night photo. Left almost untouched on purpose.

edits: cropped out the ceiling lights and most of the furniture
evened out the dim top of the wall
white balance so the wall reads white instead of grey-green
photos.note: Mixed window and fluorescent light leaves a faint cool tint on the far left of the wall.

edits: trimmed empty road and tree tops
lifted shadows on the shaded side of the truck
photos.note: Truck is backlit and parked in tree shade, and the file was smoothed by earlier processing. The truck fills the frame edge to edge, so there is no room to reframe.
